description: Client-side JavaScript code defining a web component for the account registration page in an OpenCart project, handling form rendering, event binding, and dynamic UI updates based on customer group data.

classes.name: AccountRegister
classes.description: A custom web component class managing the account registration form, including rendering, event handling, and dynamic field updates.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Initializes the component, loads data, and renders the registration form.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Sets the inner HTML of the component to display the registration form.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Binds event listeners to form elements for submission and customer group changes.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the customer group selection, updating custom fields dynamically.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Prevents default form submission and initiates registration request.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Displays success or error messages based on registration response.
